extracted.intended_audience: merchants, shopkeepers, and bookkeepers keeping commercial ledgers (historical Italian context)
extracted.subtask_description: Practical rules for keeping journals, ledgers, inventories, debtor/creditor accounts, and supporting documents for a merchant's shop; covers daily entries, error correction, annual closing, transfers, and handling of small/extraordinary items. Geared toward hands-on shop/account record-keeping.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record transactions in both giornale and quaderno (journal and book)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tenere scritte tutte le partite nel giornale e nel quaderno; trasferire le voci dal giornale al quaderno e mantenerne l'ordine.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make daily entries in the giornale and subsequently post them to the quaderno/ledger in order; use the journal as the primary daily record and the ledger for organized accounts and balances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinguish and separately record ordinary vs extraordinary expenses
rubrics_metrics.description: Separare le spese cafà ordinarie e spese straordinarie; riconoscere che alcune voci sono ordinarie e altre no.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep ordinary operating expenses apart from extraordinary items; record them in distinct accounts so the reader can see routine costs vs exceptional outlays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventory and treat merchandise as debitrici/creditrici in the books
rubrics_metrics.description: Fare l'inventario delle robbe che si mettono in bottega e renderle 'debitrici' nel tuo libro e 'creditrici' altrove; mettere le robbe una per una.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List goods item-by-item as if the shop were a single debtor/creditor; this makes it easy to see what merchandise makes you debtor (your stock) and how it matches creditors' accounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not record insignificant trivial items individually
rubrics_metrics.description: Le cose piccole, di minima importanza, non meritano la spesa di annotarle una per una.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid cluttering ledgers with minute items of negligible value; group or omit trivial expenditures to keep books readable and useful.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use indexes/alphabet and clear referencing for large ledgers
rubrics_metrics.description: Affettare l'alfabeto e mettere i riferimenti in modo che si possano ritrovare facilmente i conti nel libro grande.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain an alphabetic index or clear references so accounts and names in a large ledger can be located quickly; post summaries to a main ledger with index entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain debtor and creditor accounts with names and balances
rubrics_metrics.description: Fare i conti di debitori e creditori, segnare i nomi, le somme e come variano i saldi; rendere la carta dei conti autentica.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep separate, clearly named debtor and creditor accounts, record each person's transactions, and update balances so you can see who owes and who is owed at any time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obtain and preserve written receipts, quittances, and endorsed papers
rubrics_metrics.description: Far fare quietanze buone e chiare, trattenere polizze e scritti di mano che servono da testimonianza quando si mutano crediti.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Secure written proof for assignments or payments (receipts, endorsements); keep originals or copies in the book so claims can later be proven.

rubrics_metrics.name: When assigning or changing a credit, record endorsements and keep documentary evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Se cambi un credito da uno a un altro, verificarne il mutamento con scritti, quietanze e far tornare i documenti al libro.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document every transfer of credit (assignment) with proper endorsements and note them in the ledger; request the endorsed paper back or keep a record of the transaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record transportation, carriage and shipment details and losses
rubrics_metrics.description: Annotare le spese di barca, carico, scarico e perdite (mare, fuoco, ecc.) e considerare le cause che rendono necessarie tali voci.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When goods are transported, record carriage costs and any damages or losses so they can be accounted for; post them to appropriate accounts and reflect adjustments in inventories and balances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use memoriale (memorandum) and auxiliary books to collect items for posting
rubrics_metrics.description: Tenere memoriale e altri quaderni particolari per raccogliere le voci che poi si riportano nel giornale e nel quaderno principale.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use a small memorandum or auxiliary book to jot transactions as they occur and then transfer them in due order to the journal and ledger to preserve sequence and completeness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct errors by retraction and counter-entries rather than erasure
rubrics_metrics.description: Se trovi errori nel quaderno, fare la retrattazione in altro luogo o annullare con segni e riportare la correzione; non cancellare fraudolentemente.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mark erroneous entries, make corrective entries (contrapartite) and note the reason and place of retraction so the record remains auditable and honest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Perform annual inventory and transfer balances at year-end
rubrics_metrics.description: Ogni anno fare inventario, togliere i saldi e riportare i risultati in una partita su foglio, confrontando e riassumendo per il bilancio.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: At the end of the year prepare a full inventory and closing entries; produce summary sheets and transfer net balances to the new year's books for clear annual accounting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep bank/banco accounts and partner accounts separately and clearly
rubrics_metrics.description: Registrare conti di banco e di compagni separatamente, indicare quando i soldi o gli effetti sono al banco e chi è il padrone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain distinct accounts for bank transactions and partners so funds and obligations are traceable; note signatures or authorities for bank entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record entries with place, date, and circumstances for clarity
rubrics_metrics.description: Mettere il luogo, la data e le condizioni (patti, condizioni) fra le parti quando si scrive e si porta in libro.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always include contextual information (where/when/under what terms) on entries that represent agreements or deliveries so obligations can be understood later.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinguish and post Dare (debit) and Avere (credit) properly
rubrics_metrics.description: Mettere correttamente le voci in Dare e in Avere; registrare la differenza e poi valutare guadagni o perdite nel bilancio.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the double-entry convention of debits and credits; post items to the correct side and reconcile periodically to determine profits or deficits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep petty/auxiliary accounts for small shops or special items
rubrics_metrics.description: Per le cose piccole (barbiere, carozze, piccoli traffici) tenere conti separati o tenerle in un folio a parte.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use special petty ledgers or folios for minor trades or recurrent small items to avoid cluttering main books, then summarize periodically in the principal ledger.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid fraudulent bookkeeping and ensure legibility and good order
rubrics_metrics.description: Non mettere falsità nel quaderno; mantenere scritture chiare, ordine e diligenza: 'mai mettere nel quaderno che sia malitia'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep honest, legible, and orderly records; avoid ambiguous or deceptive notations and keep all entries in a consistent, auditable manner.

rubrics_metrics.name: If transferring accounts between books, use clear cross-references
rubrics_metrics.description: Quando si porta una partita da un libro all'altro, porre riferimenti, segnare le pagine e mettere segni di trasporto per ritrovare la linea.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When moving or summarizing accounts across books, indicate the source and destination (page numbers, marks) so one can trace each posting back to its original entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep original supporting documents attached or referenced
rubrics_metrics.description: Conservare carte, quietanze e documenti che provano le partite; non bastano solo le note orali.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach or index invoices, receipts, bills of exchange and other proofs to the related ledger entries to provide documentary evidence for later disputes or audits.
